description: This file defines a static internal class GrainMetricsListener that subscribes to metrics related to grain counts in Orleans. It sets up a MeterListener to listen for specific instrument events and updates a concurrent dictionary accordingly.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the MeterListener to begin listening for measurement events.

methods.name: OnMeasurementRecorded
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a measurement is recorded; updates grain count metrics based on measurement values.
